evidences.evidence_quote: Vib2audio exploits Capon beamformer [23] to locate the position of the received signal among multiple signal sources and enhance the target signal.
evidences.evidence_context: To identify multiple reflected objects in a complex environment, it is necessary to analyze the azimuth of the reflected objects. Vib2audio exploits Capon beamformer [23] to locate the position of the received signal among multiple signal sources and enhance the target signal.
evidences.reference_entry: J. Li, P. Stoica, and Z. Wang, "On robust Capon beamforming and diagonal loading," IEEE Trans. Signal Process., vol. 51, no. 7, pp. 1702–1715, Jul. 2003.
